distribution: Sanitized metric summary. Original reports, private implementation and data are not bundled.

scenes.role: development evidence; not a fresh final holdout

limitations: Neutral sensitometry and separable effective dye model do not validate colored-film response.
GH7 channel relative scale unavailable; fixed CCM compatibility unverified.
Adaptive roll calibration and display used an external private application, not this repository.

numerical_verification.model_quality: qualitative demonstration only; no independent exposure-to-print validation

optical_print_5207_ultra_endura.limits: Test-patch latent coefficients were fitted to each measured spectrum. White envelope and enlarger filters are modeled, not measured paper base or a specific enlarger.

numerical_verification.scope: Numerical implementation and saved artifact consistency only, NOT independent measured E100 color validation.

checks.physical_transmittance_range: 0 < T <= 1 for all saved pixels and bands
checks.HSI_above_1_policy: Original measured reflectance factors retained, not clipped before exposure; these may include specular/measurement effects and are not a proof of diffuse reflectance <=1.

exposure.illuminant: CIE D55 energy SPD, declared daylight approximation
exposure.reference: Each layer exposure origin aligned with the same 18% spectrally flat gray under D55. Published log-sensitivities converted to linear before integration. This neutral alignment is a model calibration, not measured shutter/lens exposure.
exposure.anchor_definition: Neutral trajectory D50 visual transmission Y=0.1 (visual density 1.0); chosen simulation convention, NOT manufacturer 18%-gray camera calibration.
exposure.outside_trace: Zero linear sensitivity outside published per-layer traces; characteristic endpoint hold outside common logH range.

viewing.colorimetry: CIE1931 2deg; finite-band white Bradford-adapted to sRGB D65
viewing.gain_definition: One scalar, shared across all scenes and all EVs, maps model 18% neutral from Y=0.1 to Y=0.18. No per-channel white balance, no image-based grading.
viewing.source_reference: Scene D55 spectrum on measured 400-720nm/10nm support, gray Y=.18, display gain=1. Different from previous reference PNGs that used gain .5.

limitations: Three fixed manufacturer dye shapes with nonnegative effective coefficients; residual base/fog is absorbed into coefficients, no separately measured base spectrum.
Neutral StatusA trajectories are fit constraints, not independent color validation.
Independent layer exposure drives the corresponding CMY coefficient; no measured interlayer/interimage development model.
Only published finite spectral support; no reconstructed UV/IR, film grain, lens flare or E6 chemistry.
D55 exposure approximation, neutral exposure-origin calibration and viewing intensity are declared choices. No physical ISO100 shutter calibration claimed.
No independently measured E100 color-chart exposures and transmissions: cannot claim this reproduces real E100 color accuracy.
